question: Which pension system's investment consultant RFP requires respondents to have at least five defined benefit pension plan clients, two of which are public pension plans with total plan assets of at least $15 billion each?
gold_answer: Orange County Employees Retirement System (OCERS), in its 2021 investment consultant services RFP (Appendix E, Minimum Qualifications Certification).
acceptance: OCERS/Orange County Employees Retirement System suffices. Appendix designation, year and restatement of qualification are optional.
candidate_answer: It is the **Orange County Employees Retirement System (OCERS)**. Its investment consultant RFP states that respondents must have at least five defined-benefit pension plan clients, including two public pension plans with at least $15 billion in total plan assets each. [Source: OCERS Investment Consultant Services RFP, Appendix E, p. 22](OCERS__investment_consultant_services_rfp.pdf#page=22)
